# Press release: press-release (PREL)

One official press release: its title, publisher, date, summary and the link to the original. One row per press release, keyed by RELEASE_ID. Read by the **official-news** pack's connector `officialnews-store` (table `<root>/officialnews/press-release/`). There is **no committed test data** for this kind: the sample comes from the pack's samples (`config/packs/economy/official-news/samples/press-release.jsonl`, 18 records). A bank or a public refresh delivers it in the same JSON Lines shape.

## File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `config/packs/economy/official-news/samples/press-release.jsonl` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line |
| Key field | `RELEASE_ID` |
| Date field | none in the record: the pack's samples are served on every business date (partition `business_date`) |
| Promoted columns | `TITLE`, `PUBLISHED`, `DATE`, `URL`, `CATEGORY`, `RELEASE_SOURCE`, `PUBLISHER_NAME`, `COUNTRY`, `INTERNAL_ONLY` |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | no committed files |

## One sample record

A real record, the most complete of the 18 (the one with the most non-empty fields), pretty-printed with two-space indents. **A string such as `"… 506 more numbers"` inside an array marks a fold**: it stands for the elements left out and is not part of the data.

```json
{
  "CATEGORY": "Enforcement Actions",
  "COUNTRY": "USA",
  "DATE": "2026-11-05",
  "INTERNAL_ONLY": false,
  "PROVENANCE": {
    "ATTRIBUTION": "Source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System.",
    "DATASET": "Federal Reserve Board: press releases",
    "INTERNAL_ONLY": false,
    "LICENCE": "Public domain (US government work); cite the Board as the source",
    "RETRIEVED_AT": "2026-11-06",
    "SOURCE": "Federal Reserve Board",
    "URL": "https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/enforcement20261105a.htm"
  },
  "PUBLISHED": "2026-11-05T16:00:00Z",
  "PUBLISHER_NAME": "Federal Reserve Board",
  "PUBLISHER_TYPE": "central bank",
  "RELEASE_ID": "PREL-FED-0224349908",
  "RELEASE_SOURCE": "PRESS-FED",
  "SUMMARY": "Federal Reserve Board announces termination of enforcement action with Allegiant United Holdings, LLC, Nano Financial Holdings, Inc., and Nano Banc",
  "TITLE": "Federal Reserve Board announces termination of enforcement action with Allegiant United Holdings, LLC, Nano Financial Holdings, Inc., and Nano Banc",
  "URL": "https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/enforcement20261105a.htm"
}
```

## Field reference

Every field of the record above, nested ones as dotted paths (`[]` marks an array of objects). *Required* is the contract's; *in N%* is how often the test data fills it.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning | Values, format, unit | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `CATEGORY` | string | optional (filled in 67% of rows) | The publisher's category (the Federal Register: the document type and agencies). | seen: `Enforcement Actions`, `Monetary Policy`, `Orders on Banking Applications`, `Banking and Consumer Regulatory Policy`, `Other Announcements` | `"Enforcement Actions"` |
| `COUNTRY` | string | required | The ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code of the publisher's country (EMU for the euro area). | seen: `USA`, `EMU` | `"USA"` |
| `DATE` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | optional (filled in every row) | The day it was published (UTC). | — | `"2026-11-05"` |
| `INTERNAL_ONLY` | boolean | required | True when the publisher's terms allow no commercial reuse: the record stays inside the organisation (Export data refuses it). | — | `false` |
| `PROVENANCE` | object | required | Where the record comes from, one object: SOURCE, DATASET, RETRIEVED_AT, LICENCE, ATTRIBUTION, URL and INTERNAL_ONLY. | — | {…} |
| `PROVENANCE.ATTRIBUTION` | string | required | The credit line to repeat when the release is shown or republished. | seen: `Source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System.`, `Source: European Central Bank.` | `"Source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System."` |
| `PROVENANCE.DATASET` | string | required | The publisher's feed the record was read from. | seen: `Federal Reserve Board: press releases`, `European Central Bank: press releases` | `"Federal Reserve Board: press releases"` |
| `PROVENANCE.INTERNAL_ONLY` | boolean | required | True when the publisher's terms allow no commercial reuse: the record stays inside the organisation (Export data refuses it). | — | `false` |
| `PROVENANCE.LICENCE` | string | required | The publisher's terms of reuse, as recorded in the feed's YAML. | seen: `Public domain (US government work); cite the Board as the source`, `ECB copyright: free use with the ECB cited as the source; inside a paid product, buyers told the information is free on ecb.europa.eu` | `"Public domain (US government work); cite the Board as the …` |
| `PROVENANCE.RETRIEVED_AT` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The business date of the feed's pull that wrote the record. | — | `"2026-11-06"` |
| `PROVENANCE.SOURCE` | string | required | The publisher. | seen: `Federal Reserve Board`, `European Central Bank` | `"Federal Reserve Board"` |
| `PROVENANCE.URL` | string | required | The original on the publisher's site. | — | `"https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/en…` |
| `PUBLISHED` | timestamp (ISO-8601) | optional (filled in every row) | When the release was published, in UTC. | — | `"2026-11-05T16:00:00Z"` |
| `PUBLISHER_NAME` | string | required | The publisher's name. | seen: `Federal Reserve Board`, `European Central Bank` | `"Federal Reserve Board"` |
| `PUBLISHER_TYPE` | string | required | What the publisher is. | one of `central bank`, `regulator`, `government` | `"central bank"` |
| `RELEASE_ID` | string | required | PREL-, the publisher's id and the first ten hex digits of the SHA-1 of the release's address. | pattern `^PREL-` | `"PREL-FED-0224349908"` |
| `RELEASE_SOURCE` | string | required | The publisher's page (PRESS-<id>). | pattern `^PRESS-`; links to `release-source` | `"PRESS-FED"` |
| `SUMMARY` | string | optional (filled in 67% of rows) | The summary the publisher's feed gives, as plain text cut at 400 characters; empty when the feed gives none. | — | `"Federal Reserve Board announces termination of enforcement…` |
| `TITLE` | string | required | The release's title as the publisher's feed gives it. | — | `"Federal Reserve Board announces termination of enforcement…` |
| `URL` | string | required | The release on the publisher's site: open it for the full text. | — | `"https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/en…` |

## Fields in other rows

None: all 18 rows were read, and every field any of them has is in the record above.

## For the production query

- **Identity:** one record per `RELEASE_ID` per `snapshot`; the key is text, unique within the date.
- **Never null:** `RELEASE_ID`, `TITLE`, `URL`, `RELEASE_SOURCE`, `PUBLISHER_NAME`, `PUBLISHER_TYPE`, `COUNTRY`, `INTERNAL_ONLY`, `PROVENANCE` (the contract's required fields); every row of the test data also fills `DATE`, `PUBLISHED`.
- **Format:** JSON Lines, UTF-8, one object a line, gzip; field names exactly as shown (UPPER_SNAKE); dates `YYYY-MM-DD`; numbers as JSON numbers, never strings; a missing value is `null` or absent (an empty string is read as empty).
- **Arrays:** keep the order shown (vectors in the scenario set's or the run's order); nested objects as JSON, never flattened.
- Unique: `RELEASE_ID` per snapshot.
- `RELEASE_ID` matches `^PREL-`.
